concerns.text: Task T006 (Compute ingestion success‑rate metric) runs before Task T007 (Validate / synthesize missing degradation labels). The success‑rate metric should be calculated after label validation because it counts records with a valid label, which may be added synthetically in T007. This consumer‑before‑producer ordering violates the data‑flow dependency.

Task T010 (Compute SHA‑256 checksums for all major artifacts) is placed before Task T012 (Data augmentation). Since T010 is supposed to checksum files under `data/augmented/graphs/`, it must run after augmentation creates those files. Running it earlier results in missing checksum entries, breaking the artifact‑integrity requirement.
